# Returns
Unworn items with the tags attached can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start a return at shop.example/returns and print the prepaid label. Sale items can be returned on the same terms. Items bought with a gift card are refunded as store credit.

# Returns
Unworn items can be returned within 14 days of delivery. Sale items cannot be returned.

# Refunds
Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days after the return reaches our warehouse. Delivery costs are refunded only when the whole order is returned.

# Delivery
Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days and is free for orders over 50 EUR. Express delivery takes 1-2 business days and costs 9 EUR. Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees.

# Ticket
